author: Pallas, 1811
summary: 바닷가의 섬이나 바다에서 생활하며, 헤엄치고 잠수하면서 먹이를 찾는다. 4월 상순~6월 상순에 광택 없는 회백색 바탕에 연한 갈색이나 어두운 회색 줄무늬와 점이 드문드문 있는 알을 1개 낳는다. 부위별 길이는 날개 172~182mm, 꽁지 45~62mm, 발목 28~32mm, 부리 32~39mm이다. 한국의 평안북도 엽도와 강원도 통천, 알래스카 남부, 캘리포니아, 아무르, 사할린, 일본 북부 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Rhinoceros Auklet (Cerorhinca monocerata), adult in non-breeding plumage as seen off the Korean east coast in winter: head, back, wings and tail dark sooty grey-brown; face and neck sides slightly paler grey-brown, the white facial plumes absent or only faintly indicated; throat, breast and flanks dusky grey-brown, blending into the white belly; no horn on the bill. Bill thick and deep, dull yellowish-orange to brownish-yellow; pale yellow iris.
art.pose: swimming on the sea, about to dive
art.scene: sea around an offshore island off the Korean east coast in winter, cold blue-grey water with a low swell; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (spring), side view swimming: orange-yellow bill with an upright pale horn at the base, one white plume line from behind the eye and another from the gape, blackish-brown back, brownish dark grey throat and upper breast, white belly
adult non-breeding plumage (winter), side view swimming: no horn, duller yellowish bill, facial plumes absent or faint, dark grey-brown head, throat and breast, white belly
art.build: Medium-sized, thickset auk, about the size of a feral pigeon but much bulkier, with a large head, thick neck and a heavy, deep, laterally compressed bill shorter than the head. Swims low on the sea and dives often and for long periods. Wings short and narrow; fast, direct, whirring flight low over the water, the bird looking uniformly dark with a white belly. In the breeding season an upright pale horn grows from the base of the upper mandible and two white plume lines adorn each side of the face.
avoid: Do not paint a massive triangular puffin bill or a white face (Tufted and Horned Puffins).
Do not paint the throat and breast white; they are dusky grey-brown in all plumages and only the belly is white.
Do not paint the horn or bright white plumes on winter birds.
Do not paint crisp black-and-white plumage like a guillemot or murrelet; the upperparts are sooty grey-brown.
